item.title: Amended EUDR regulation to exclude books
item.description: Today the European Parliament plenary voted in favour of the provisional agreement reached with the Council on the EUDR-amending Regulation. This means ‘printed books, newspapers, pictures and other products of the printing industry, manuscripts, typescripts and plans, of paper’ have been exempted from the EUDR. item.title: Caroline Criado Perez to deliver Unwin Lecture
item.description: Caroline Criado Perez – writer, broadcaster, feminist campaigner and winner of the inaugural Unwin Award – will deliver this year’s Unwin Lecture. The Lecture will focus on the value that publishing brings to society and will take place on Tuesday 21 April at the Royal Institution. Registration for the Lecture is now open. item.title: The Unwin Award 2026: Shortlist Announcement
item.description: The Unwin Award 2026 has revealed the six writers shortlisted for this year’s literary award, recognising non-fiction writers in the earlier stages of their careers as authors, whose work is considered to have made a significant contribution to the world. Worth £10,000, the Unwin Award recognises authors for their overall body of work, with the winner set to be revealed at a ceremony held at The Royal Institution in London on 21 April 2026. item.title: Latest government statement and analysis on copyright and AI
item.description: Today, the Secretary of State for Science, Innovation and Technology, the Rt Hon Liz Kendall MP, has made a statement on copyright and AI progress.
